Description:
Help organizations join the platform and list their leftover materials. Covers signing up, adding materials, managing stock, and keeping quantities accurate.

Target outcome: A verified organization can sign up, list surplus materials, and easily see what is available, reserved, or delivered.

Check the condition and quality of listed materials before buyers see them. Certified inspectors review each item so only good-quality materials are shared.

Target outcome: Buyers only see materials that have passed quality checks, with clear photos and condition notes.

Help buyers quickly find the materials they need using simple search, category filters, distance, and project requirements.

Target outcome: Buyers can search by keyword or nearby location and instantly find matching, verified materials.

Handle requests, reservations, and delivery tracking. Covers supplier approval, transport updates, delivery confirmation, and fixing quantity mismatches.

Target outcome: Buyers can request items, suppliers can approve holds, and both sides can track deliveries from pickup to drop-off.

Give managers clear reports on saved materials, avoided waste, user accounts, and platform activity.

Target outcome: Managers can see how much waste was prevented, view environmental savings, and manage member accounts.
